title: TOngue/Palate Interactions Study
official: Experimental Study of Tongue/Palate Interactions Using Upper coMplete dEnture
summary: The project aims to assess the effect of a complete denture of new denture wearers on speech production using sensors placed inside a duplicate of the prosthesis according to the technique described in the PRESLA system. Secondly, it aims to assess the effect of a complete denture on swallowing for these new denture wearers. Thirdly it aims to describe a precise mapping of the mechanical pressures exerted by the tongue on the palate of complete denture user, been used in wearing denture, during speaking and swallowing. The experiments will take place in the department of treatments and dental consultations of the Hospices Civils de Lyon (Faculty of Odontology, Lyon, France).

interventions.name: Tongue pressure recordings with the PRESLA prothesis for the Arm1 (patients wearing the complete denture for the first time)
Tongue pressure recordings with the PRESLA prothesis for the Arm2 (patients used to wear the complete denture)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Bimaxillary edentulous patients of both genders, over 18 years of age, requiring prosthesis (Cohort 1).
* Bimaxillary edentulous patients of both genders, over 18 years of age, with prosthesis made since at least one year (Cohort 2).
* Patients Affiliated with the French Social Security Insurance

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with speech or neurological disorders, or uncorrected or psychiatric sensory disorders
* Patients without French as native language
* Pregnant women
* Patients deprived of liberty or provided with legal protection
* Patients unable to support study constraints as determined by investigator
* Patients who have expressed their refusal to participate with the investigator
* Allergy to methacrylic resin
